description: Traffic Flow Dataset for "Traffic Signal Timing Optimization: From Evolution to Adaptation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sheng-Hao Wu, Zhi-Hui Zhan (Nankai University). This dataset is designed for Traffic Signal Timing Optimization (TSTO) studies using the SUMO simulation environment. It includes traffic volume inputs, τ, for initiating and evaluating traffic simulations across diverse road network configurations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
